# Cursor Changelog — captured 2026-05-20

## May 19, 2026 — Cursor in Jira
Cursor integrated with Jira. Users can assign work items directly to cloud agents or mention @Cursor in Jira comments. The system uses ticket context to scope tasks and generates pull requests upon completion.

## May 18, 2026 — Composer 2.5
Upgraded Cursor model. Better long-running tasks, instruction following.
- Standard tier: $0.50/M input, $2.50/M output tokens
- Fast tier (default): $3.00/M input, $15.00/M output tokens

## May 13, 2026 (Version 3.4) — Full-screen Tabs and Compact Chats

## May 13, 2026 — Development Environments for Cloud Agents (multi-repo)

## May 11, 2026 — Cursor in Microsoft Teams (@Cursor mentions)

## May 7, 2026 — Build in Parallel / /multitask
